note: This file is not a fixture. Fixtures are directories containing fixture.json and tree/.

fixture.json.description: why this case exists and what it would catch
fixture.json.tuning: true if the analyzer's rules were derived from this case; excluded from numbers
fixture.json.fact: the migration fact handed to the matcher
fixture.json.true_affected_paths: the ground truth, relative to tree/

contract.tree/: a small source tree the matcher runs over

forbidden: A fixture must never declare what the matcher is expected to predict. Grading a prediction that came from the fixture file measures nothing.
